# Scripting API

Native functions available to every scripting language (ConquerorScript, Luau, LuaQ, Python, C#, Java, C++, C, Rust, Zig and Visual Script nodes). The names are identical in all languages; see [Scripting](../Scripting.md) for how each language calls them. Functions that act on "this" use the entity the script is attached to.

618 functions in 46 categories.

## AI

| Function | Description |
|---|---|

| `BlackboardSet(target, "Key", value) -> bool` | Writes a Behavior Tree blackboard key. |
| `BlackboardSetVector(target, "Key", x, y, z) -> bool` | Writes a Vector blackboard key. |

| `EQSRunAsset("Assets/AI/FindCover.cqeqs", querier, target = null) -> [{x,y,z,score,entity}]` | Runs a saved .cqeqs query; tests with Context: target use the given target object. |

## Abilities

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `AbilityCooldown(target, name) -> float` | Remaining cooldown in seconds. |
| `AbilityGrant(target, name, cooldown = 0, costAttribute = "", costAmount = 0, blockedTags, requiredTags) -> bool` | Grants (or redefines) an ability. |
| `AbilityLastFailure(target = self) -> string` | Why the last activation failed (cooldown, cost, blocked ...). |
| `AbilityTryActivate(target, name) -> bool` | Checks cooldown, cost and tags, pays the cost and sends OnAbilityActivated(name). |
| `AttrAdd(target, name, delta) -> bool` | Instant change of an attribute's base value. |
| `AttrDefine(target, name, base, min = -inf, max = +inf) -> bool` | Creates or redefines an attribute (adds an Ability System if needed). |
| `AttrGet(target, "Health") -> float \| null` | Current value of an Ability System attribute. |
| `AttrGetBase(target, name) -> float \| null` | Base value of an attribute (without temporary modifiers). |
| `AttrSetBase(target, name, value) -> bool` | Sets the base value of an attribute (clamped). |
| `EffectApply(target, {name, duration, period, modifiers, tags, stacking, maxStacks}) -> handle` | Applies a gameplay effect: instant (duration 0), timed or periodic; 0 if blocked. |
| `EffectApplyFromTable(target, tablePath, rowName) -> handle` | Applies an effect defined in a data table row (Duration, Period, Modifiers, Tags, Stacking, MaxStacks). |
| `EffectHas(target, name) -> bool` | True while the effect is active. |
| `EffectRemove(target, handle \| name) -> int` | Removes active effects; returns how many. |
| `EffectStacks(target, name) -> int` | Stack count of an active effect (0 if absent). |

## Animation

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `AnimationIsPlaying([entity]) -> bool` | True while the Animation component plays a clip. |
| `AnimationPlay([entity,] ["Assets/Door.cqanim"]) -> bool` | Plays the Animation component's clip (or the given Animation Clip) from the start. |

| `AnimGetState(target = self, layer = 0) -> string` | Current state of an Animation (state machine) layer. |
| `AnimMontageGetName(target = self) -> string` | Name of the playing montage ("" if none). |
| `AnimMontageGetPosition(target = self) -> seconds` | Playback position of the montage clip. |
| `AnimMontageGetSection(target = self) -> string` | Current montage section. |
| `AnimMontageGetWeight(target = self) -> float` | Current blend weight of the montage (0..1). |
| `AnimMontageIsPlaying(target = self, name = null) -> bool` | Is a montage (optionally with this name) playing. |
| `AnimMontageJumpToSection(target, section) -> bool` | Jumps the playing montage to a section. |
| `AnimMontagePlay(target, "Assets/Anim/Attack.cqmontage" \| clipName, rate = 1, section = "", blendIn = -1, blendOut = -1, fromBone = "") -> seconds` | Plays a one-shot montage over the state machine (target may be the character root). fromBone limits it to that bone and its children (upper-body attacks while running). Events: OnMontageBlendingOut(name, interrupted), OnMontageEnded(name, interrupted). Returns 0 on failure. |
| `AnimMontageSetNextSection(target, fromSection, toSection) -> bool` | When fromSection ends continue with toSection (combos; "Stop" ends the montage, a section linked to itself loops). |
| `AnimMontageStop(target = self, blendOut = -1) -> bool` | Blends the playing montage out (interrupted = true). |
| `GetBoneLocalPosition(target, "hand_r") -> {x, y, z}` | Position of a bone in the skinned model's own space (final pose, after IK). Independent of the model's world transform. |
| `GetBonePosition(target, "LeftHand") -> {x, y, z}` | World position of a bone of a skinned model in its final pose (after IK). Name suffixes match ("Hand" finds "mixamorig:LeftHand"). |

| `TilemapSetCellColor(map, x, y, r, g, b, a) -> bool` | Tints a painted cell (highlights, fog of war). |
| `TilemapSetCellElevation(map, x, y, elevation) -> bool` | Raises a painted 3D cell (hills, cliffs). |
| `TilemapSetTile(map, x, y, tile, r = 1, g = 1, b = 1, a = 1) -> bool` | Paints a palette tile into a cell (optional per-cell tint). |
| `TilemapSetTileType(map, index, props) -> bool` | Sets palette entry fields from a map: Name, Color {r,g,b,a}, Texture, Solid, Walkable, Cost, Height, Autotile (0 none, 1 = 16-tile, 2 = 47-tile blob), Terrain. |
| `TilemapTileCount(map) -> int` | Number of painted cells. |

## Input

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `ForceFeedbackPlay("Assets/X.cqforcefeedback", gamepad = 0, scale = 1) -> bool` | Plays a gamepad vibration effect. |
| `ForceFeedbackStop(path = null)` | Stops vibration effects. |
| `GetButtonGlyph(spec) -> string` | Texture path of the button icon for the current device. spec: "a", "dpad_up", "key_space", "a\|key_space" or an input action name. |
| `GetButtonLabel(spec) -> string` | Button name for the current device: "A", "Cross", "Space" ... |
| `GetGamepadAxis(pad, axis) -> float` | Raw axis (0 LX, 1 LY, 2 RX, 3 RY, 4 LT, 5 RT). One argument = axis on pad 0. |
| `GetGamepadLeftStick(pad) -> {x, y}` | Left stick (-1..1). |
| `GetGamepadLeftTrigger(pad = 0) -> float` | Left trigger (0..1). |
| `GetGamepadRightStick(pad) -> {x, y}` | Right stick (-1..1). |
| `GetGamepadRightTrigger(pad = 0) -> float` | Right trigger (0..1). |
| `GetGamepadStyle() -> string` | Glyph style shown now: Keyboard, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo or SteamDeck (follows the last used device). |
| `GetMouseDelta() -> {x, y}` | Cursor movement since last frame. |
| `GetMousePosition() -> {x, y}` | Cursor position in window pixels. |
| `GetMouseScrollDelta() -> float` | Wheel movement this frame. |
| `InputActionCanceled("Jump") -> bool` | True in the frame a Project-wide Actions action was canceled. |
| `InputActionPerformed("Jump") -> bool` | True in the frame a Project-wide Actions action was performed. |
| `InputActionPhase("Jump") -> string` | Phase of a Project-wide Actions action: Waiting, Started, Performed or Canceled. |
| `InputActionStarted("Jump") -> bool` | True in the frame a Project-wide Actions action started. |
| `InputActionVector("Player/Move") -> {x, y}` | 2D value of a Project-wide Actions action (Project Settings > Input). |
| `IsGamepadButtonPressed(pad, button) -> bool` | Gamepad button held (0 A, 1 B, 2 X, 3 Y, 4 LB, 5 RB, 6 Back, 7 Start, 8 Guide, 9 LS, 10 RS, 11-14 D-pad up/right/down/left). One argument = button on pad 0. |
| `IsGamepadConnected(pad = 0) -> bool` | True if the gamepad is plugged in. |
| `IsKeyDown(Key.X) -> bool` | True on the frame the key went down. |
| `IsKeyPressed(Key.X) -> bool` | True while the key is held. |
| `IsKeyUp(Key.X) -> bool` | True on the frame the key was released. |
| `IsMouseButtonDown(button) -> bool` | True on the frame the button went down. |
| `IsMouseButtonPressed(button) -> bool` | 0 left, 1 right, 2 middle. |
| `IsSteamDeck() -> bool` | True when running on a Steam Deck. |
| `IsUsingGamepad() -> bool` | True when the player last used a gamepad (false: keyboard / mouse). |
| `PlayerInputCanceled([target,] "Interact") -> bool` | True in the frame the action was canceled (released early, held too long for a Tap). |
| `PlayerInputIndex(target) -> int` | Gamepad assigned to this player (-1 = keyboard only). |
| `PlayerInputLook(target) -> {x, y}` | Look delta from the mouse / right stick of this player. |
| `PlayerInputMove(target) -> {x, y}` | Movement from WASD / arrows / left stick of this player (length <= 1). |
| `PlayerInputPerformed([target,] "Interact") -> bool` | True in the frame the action was performed (e.g. a Hold completed, a Tap was released). |
| `PlayerInputPhase([target,] "Interact") -> string` | Phase of an Input Actions action: Waiting, Started, Performed or Canceled. |
| `PlayerInputPressed([target,] "Jump") -> bool` | True in the frame the action started for this player. |
| `PlayerInputReleased([target,] "Jump") -> bool` | True in the frame the action ended for this player. |
| `PlayerInputStarted([target,] "Interact") -> bool` | True in the frame the action started (e.g. a Hold began). |
| `PlayerInputSwitchMap([target,] "UI") -> bool` | Switches the player's action map (Unity SwitchCurrentActionMap). |
| `PlayerInputSwitchScheme([target,] "Gamepad") -> bool` | Uses only the bindings of this control scheme ("" = all schemes). |
| `PlayerInputValue([target,] "Jump") -> float` | Current value of an action for this Player Input (button 0/1, axis -1..1). |
| `PlayerInputVector([target,] "Move") -> {x, y}` | 2D value of an action (Input Actions asset: composites, sticks, mouse delta). |
| `PlayerJoin(manager, device = -1) -> id` | Spawns a player from the Player Input Manager's prefab for a gamepad (-1 = keyboard). |
| `SetCursorMode(mode)` | 0 normal, 1 hidden, 2 locked (FPS camera). Esc or losing focus releases the lock (the cursor appears in the middle of the game view and the game gets no mouse input); clicking the game view locks it again without passing that click to the game. |
| `SetGlyphStyle(style)` | Force a glyph style (auto, keyboard, xbox, playstation, nintendo, deck). |
| `TouchInterfaceActivate("Assets/X.cqtouchinterface") -> bool` | Shows on-screen touch controls. |
| `TouchInterfaceDeactivate()` | Hides the on-screen touch controls. |

## Localization

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetLoadedLocales() -> list` | Languages that have translations (after the Locale Filter). |
| `GetLocale() -> string` | Language in use. |
| `GetSystemLocale() -> string` | Language of the operating system ("tr_TR", "en_US" ...). |
| `SetLocale(locale) -> string` | Switches the language ("tr", "pt_BR" ...); the closest loaded language is used and every translated text updates at once. Returns the language in use. |
| `Tr(key, context = "") -> string` | Translation of key in the current language (Project Settings > Localization); the key itself when there is none. |
| `TrN(key, pluralKey, n, context = "") -> string` | Plural translation: picks the form for n with the language's plural rule (PO Plural-Forms); without a translation key when n == 1, else pluralKey. |

| `MultiMeshGetPosition(entity, index) -> {x, y, z}` | Local position of one instance (null if out of range). |

## Navigation

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `NavAgentSetDestination(target, x, y, z) -> bool` | Sends a NavMesh Agent to a point (partial path to the closest reachable point if blocked). |
| `NavFindPath(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) -> [{x, y, z}]` | Corner points of the shortest path (empty if none). |
| `NavIsOnNavMesh([target]) -> bool` | True if the entity stands on the baked NavMesh. |
| `NavRaycast(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1) -> {clear, x, y, z}` | Walks a straight line on the NavMesh; clear = false stops at the first edge / obstacle. |

| `NavWarp([target,] x, y, z) -> bool` | Teleports an agent onto the NavMesh and clears its path. |

## Network

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `NetChangeOwner(entity, clientId) -> bool` | Server: gives control of an object to a client. |
| `NetClientCount() -> int` | Connected players (server side, host included). |
| `NetDespawn(entity?)` | Server: removes a network object everywhere (end of frame). |
| `NetEntityRpc(entity, target, method, args...)` | RPC on another object. target: "server", "clients", "owner" or "all". |
| `NetFindEntity(networkId) -> entity` | Entity for a network id on this machine (-1 if unknown). |
| `NetGetClients() -> list` | Connected client ids (server side). |
| `NetGetEntityVar(entity, name, default?) -> value` | Reads another object's replicated variable. |
| `NetGetLastError() -> string` | Why the last start/connect/RPC failed. |
| `NetGetNetworkId(entity?) -> int` | Id that is the same on every machine (send it in RPCs instead of entity ids). |
| `NetGetOwner(entity?) -> int` | Owner client id of a network object. |
| `NetGetPing() -> float` | Round-trip time to the server in milliseconds (client). |
| `NetGetStats() -> map` | sentKBps, receivedKBps, rtt, bytesSent, bytesReceived. |
| `NetGetStatus() -> string` | Human readable session state. |
| `NetGetVar(name, default?) -> value` | Reads a replicated variable of this object. |
| `NetIsClient() -> bool` | True on a client or host. |
| `NetIsConnected() -> bool` | Server running, or client accepted by the server. |
| `NetIsHost() -> bool` | True when this game is both server and player. |
| `NetIsOnline() -> bool` | True while a session is running (connecting included). |
| `NetIsOwner(entity?) -> bool` | True if this machine controls the object (offline: always true). |
| `NetIsServer() -> bool` | True on a server or host. |
| `NetLocalClientId() -> int` | This machine's client id (host = 0). |
| `NetRpcAll(method, args...)` | Calls method(args) on every machine, including this one. |
| `NetRpcClients(method, args...)` | Calls method(args) on every client (and the host). |
| `NetRpcOwner(method, args...)` | Calls method(args) on the machine that owns this object. |
| `NetRpcServer(method, args...)` | Calls method(args) on this object's scripts on the server. |
| `NetSend(name, value) -> bool` | Broadcast message; every machine's scripts get OnNetMessage(name, value, senderId). |
| `NetSetEntityVar(entity, name, value) -> bool` | Replicated variable on another object. |
| `NetSetVar(name, value) -> bool` | Replicated variable on this object (server or owner may write). OnNetworkVariableChanged(name, value) fires everywhere. |
| `NetShutdown()` | Leaves / stops the session at the end of the frame. Spawned network objects are removed. |
| `NetSpawn(prefab, x, y, z, owner?) -> entity` | Server: creates a prefab on every machine. owner = client id that controls it. |
| `NetStartClient(address?, port?) -> bool` | Connects to a host/server. OnClientConnected(clientId) runs when accepted. |
| `NetStartHost(port?) -> bool` | Starts a host (server + local player). Port defaults to the scene's Network Manager. |
| `NetStartServer(port?) -> bool` | Starts a dedicated server (no local player). |

| `NoisePerlin3D(x, y, z, seed = 0) -> float` | 3D Perlin noise. |

| `NoiseWorley2D(x, y, seed = 0) -> float` | Cellular (Voronoi) noise: distance to the nearest feature point. |

| `ParticleGetBounds(target = self) -> {min, max, center} \| null` | World-space bounds and centre of a particle system's live particles. |

| `ParticleRestart(target = this) -> bool` | Clears and plays from the start. |
| `ParticleSetColor(target, r, g, b, a = 1) -> bool` | Start color of new particles. |

| `ParticleStop(target = this, clear = true) -> bool` | Stops emitting; clear = false lets live particles finish. |

## Physics

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `AddExplosionForce(force, x, y, z, radius, upwards = 0)` | Pushes all dynamic bodies away from a point with falloff. |
| `AddForceAtPosition(fx, fy, fz, px, py, pz)` | Applies a force at a world point (adds torque). |
| `ApplyAngularImpulse(x, y, z)` | Instant change of angular momentum. |
| `ApplyForce(x, y, z)` | Adds a continuous force (use in Update). |
| `ApplyImpulse(x, y, z)` | Adds an instant impulse (jumps, hits). |
| `ApplyTorque(x, y, z)` | Adds rotational force. |
| `ClothGetBounds([target]) -> {minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ}` | World-space bounds of a simulated Cloth. |
| `EntityAddImpulse(entity, ix, iy, iz, px = ?, py = ?, pz = ?) -> bool` | Instant push on another rigidbody; with a world point it also spins it. |
| `EntityRaycast(entity, ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxDistance = 1000) -> hit \| null` | Ray test against one entity (and its children) by visual bounds. |
| `FractureBreak(target, x = center, y, z, impulse = 0) -> int` | Shatters the object into Voronoi pieces (adds a Fracture component if missing); returns the number of pieces. Pieces fly away from the given point. |
| `FractureIsBroken(target = self) -> bool` | Whether the object has been broken (true also when it no longer exists). |
| `GetAngularVelocity() -> {x, y, z}` | Rigidbody angular velocity. |
| `GetContactImpulse() -> float` | Estimated impact impulse. |
| `GetContactNormal() -> {x, y, z}` | Contact normal (pointing from the other body to this one). |
| `GetContactOther() -> entity` | Other entity of the current collision/trigger callback. |
| `GetContactPoint() -> {x, y, z}` | Contact point of the current collision callback. |
| `GetContactRelativeVelocity() -> {x, y, z}` | Relative velocity at impact. |
| `GetFixedDeltaTime() -> float` | Physics fixed timestep in seconds. Interpolated bodies are drawn at most this far behind their simulated pose. |
| `GetGravity() -> {x, y, z}` | World gravity. |
| `GetLinearVelocity(entity = self) -> {x, y, z}` | Rigidbody velocity. |
| `GetMass() -> float` | Mass of this entity's rigidbody. |
| `GetPhysicsBackend() -> string` | Active 3D physics engine (Jolt or MuJoCo). |
| `IsSleeping() -> bool` | True if the rigidbody is asleep. |
| `JointGetAngle() -> float` | Current hinge angle in degrees. |
| `JointIsBroken() -> bool` | True if a joint on this entity broke. |
| `JointSetMotor(enabled, targetVelocity, maxForce)` | Drives this entity's Hinge (deg/s) or Slider (m/s) joint motor. |
| `OverlapBox(x, y, z, hx, hy, hz, layerMask = -1) -> [entity]` | Entities whose colliders overlap an axis-aligned box (half extents). |
| `OverlapSphere(x, y, z, radius, layerMask = -1) -> [entity]` | Entities whose colliders overlap a sphere. |
| `RagdollActivate(target, ix = 0, iy = 0, iz = 0, px = 0, py = 0, pz = 0) -> bool` | Switches a skinned character from animation to a physics ragdoll built from its skeleton (adds a Ragdoll component if missing). With a point the impulse is applied to the body nearest to it; without one it is spread over the whole body by mass (the character is shoved as one piece). |
| `RagdollDeactivate(target = self) -> bool` | Removes the ragdoll bodies and returns to animation. |
| `RagdollGetBodyCount(target = self) -> int` | Number of physics bodies of the active ragdoll. |
| `RagdollIsActive(target = self) -> bool` | Whether the ragdoll is simulating. |
| `Raycast(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxDistance = 1000, layerMask = -1, ignoreSelf = false) -> {entity, name, point, normal, distance, isTrigger}` | Casts a ray; returns the closest hit or null. ignoreSelf skips this entity (e.g. the character capsule). |
| `RaycastAll(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxDistance = 1000, layerMask = -1) -> [hit]` | All hits along a ray, nearest first. |
| `RayCastForceUpdate(entity = self) -> bool` | Re-cast the ray immediately (after moving it this frame); returns whether it hits. |
| `RayCastGetCollider(entity = self) -> entity` | Object hit by the Ray Cast component (null when not colliding). |
| `RayCastGetDistance(entity = self) -> float` | Distance to the hit point (-1 when not colliding). |
| `RayCastGetNormal(entity = self) -> {x, y, z}` | Surface normal at the hit point (null when not colliding). |
| `RayCastGetPoint(entity = self) -> {x, y, z}` | World hit point of the Ray Cast component (null when not colliding). |
| `RayCastIsColliding(entity = self) -> bool` | Whether the Ray Cast component's ray hits something this frame. |
| `RayCastSetTarget(entity, x, y, z = 0) -> bool` | Change the ray's local end point. |
| `SceneRaycast(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, maxDistance = 1000, ignoreEntity = -1) -> {entity, name, point, normal, distance} \| null` | Ray test against visual bounds (meshes, sprites); works in the editor without physics. |
| `SetAngularVelocity([entity,] x, y, z)` | Sets rigidbody angular velocity. |
| `SetGravity(x, y, z)` | Sets world gravity. |
| `SetLinearVelocity([entity,] x, y, z)` | Sets rigidbody velocity. |
| `ShapeCastForceUpdate(entity = self) -> bool` | Sweeps the shape again right now (after moving it in the same frame). |
| `ShapeCastGetCollider(entity = self, index = 0) -> entity` | Object of a Shape Cast result (null if out of range). |
| `ShapeCastGetCollisionCount(entity = self) -> int` | How many objects the Shape Cast touches (nearest first). |
| `ShapeCastGetNormal(entity = self, index = 0) -> {x, y, z}` | Contact normal of a Shape Cast result (null if out of range). |
| `ShapeCastGetPoint(entity = self, index = 0) -> {x, y, z}` | Contact point of a Shape Cast result (null if out of range). |
| `ShapeCastGetSafeFraction(entity = self) -> float` | How far (0..1 of the way to Target Position) the shape can move without touching anything. |
| `ShapeCastIsColliding(entity = self) -> bool` | Whether the Shape Cast component's swept shape touches something this frame. |
| `ShapeCastSetTarget(entity, x, y, z = 0) -> bool` | Sets the Shape Cast's local target position. |
| `SphereCast(ox, oy, oz, radius, dx, dy, dz, maxDistance = 1000, layerMask = -1, ignoreSelf = false) -> hit` | Sweeps a sphere; returns the first hit or null. |
| `Teleport(x, y, z)` | Moves the entity and its physics body instantly. |
| `WakeUp()` | Wakes the rigidbody. |

## Prefs

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetPersistentDataPath() -> string` | Per-user folder for save files (relative StateSaveGame names go here). |
| `PrefsDeleteAll()` | Removes every key. |
| `PrefsDeleteKey(key)` | Removes a key. |
| `PrefsGetFloat(key, default = 0) -> float` | Stored number, or the default. |
| `PrefsGetInt(key, default = 0) -> int` | Stored integer, or the default. |
| `PrefsGetString(key, default = "") -> string` | Stored text, or the default. |
| `PrefsHasKey(key) -> bool` | True if the key exists. |
| `PrefsSave() -> bool` | Writes pending changes now (also done when play stops and on quit). |
| `PrefsSetFloat(key, value)` | Stores a number that survives restarts. |
| `PrefsSetInt(key, value)` | Stores an integer that survives restarts (high scores, settings). |
| `PrefsSetString(key, value)` | Stores text that survives restarts. |
| `StateLoadGame(fileName) -> string` | Reads a save file written by StateSaveGame (empty if missing); pair with JSONParse. |
| `StateSaveGame(fileName, text) -> bool` | Writes a save file (relative names go to GetPersistentDataPath()); pair with JSONStringify. |

| `CameraIsOrthographic(target = primary) -> bool` | True for orthographic cameras. |
| `CameraSetOrthographic(size) / CameraSetOrthographic(target, size)` | Orthographic projection (size = visible height); primary camera when no target. |
| `CameraSetPerspective(fov) / CameraSetPerspective(target, fov, near, far)` | Perspective projection (vertical FOV in degrees); target -1 = primary camera. |
| `CameraSetPrimary(target) -> bool` | Makes a camera the one that renders the game. |
| `CanvasBegin("Assets/X.cqcanvasrt") -> bool` | Starts drawing on a Canvas Render Target. |
| `CanvasClear(r, g, b, a)` | Clears the canvas. |
| `CanvasDrawRect(x, y, w, h, r, g, b, a)` | Draws a filled rectangle (top-left origin, pixels). |
| `CanvasDrawText(x, y, "text", size, r, g, b, a)` | Draws text on the canvas. |
| `CanvasDrawTexture("Assets/X.png", x, y, w, h, r, g, b, a)` | Draws a texture on the canvas. |
| `CanvasEnd() -> bool` | Finishes drawing and updates the texture. |
| `EntityGetColor(target) -> {r, g, b, a}` | Current tint (see EntitySetColor). |
| `EntityGetModel(target = self) -> string` | Project path of the object's model. |
| `EntitySetColor(target, r, g, b, a = 1) -> bool` | Tint of a Sprite Renderer, Mesh Renderer, UI Image / Text or Text Renderer. |
| `EntitySetModel(target, "Assets/Models/Rock.glb") -> bool` | Loads a 3D model (glTF/FBX/OBJ) into the object's Model component (added if missing). |
| `IsOnScreen(entity = self) -> bool` | Visible On Screen Notifier: whether the object's bounds are inside the main camera's view. |
| `MeshGenerateLODs(target = self, levels = 3, reduction = 0.5) -> int` | Adds Auto LOD to a model and builds its simplified LOD meshes now; returns the number of levels. |
| `MeshGetCurrentLOD(target = self) -> int` | LOD level the renderer picks for the object (Auto LOD component). |
| `MeshGetLODTriangles(target = self) -> [int]` | Triangle count of every LOD level of the model (LOD0 first). |
| `MPCSetScalar("Assets/X.cqmpc", "Name", value) -> bool` | Sets a Material Parameter Collection scalar. |
| `MPCSetVector("Assets/X.cqmpc", "Name", r, g, b, a) -> bool` | Sets a Material Parameter Collection vector. |
| `RenderSettingGet("Fog.Color") -> value` | Reads a scene render setting. |
| `RenderSettingNames() -> [string]` | Every setting name accepted by RenderSettingSet. |
| `RenderSettingSet("Post.BloomIntensity", 0.8) -> bool` | Changes a scene render setting (Fog.*, Shadows.*, Post.*, Environment.*); see RenderSettingNames(). |
| `SceneSetSkybox(path) -> bool` | HDR sky (.hdr / .exr) used as background, image-based lighting and reflections while Environment.Sky is Auto; "" removes it. |
| `StreamingIsPreloading(camera) -> bool` | True while the camera's preloading time runs and streamed textures are still loading. |
| `StreamingSetPreloading(camera, seconds) -> bool` | Texture Streaming: loads the textures a camera with a Streaming Controller needs before it renders (e.g. before a camera cut). |
| `TextureStreamingInfo() -> {enabled, streamingTextures, pending, streamingMB, desiredMB, totalMB, budgetMB}` | Texture Streaming state and texture memory. |
| `VertexPaintFill(target, color) -> bool` | Sets every vertex color of the object. |
| `VertexPaintGetColor(target, meshIndex, vertex) -> [r,g,b,a]` | Painted color of one vertex (white if unpainted). |
| `VertexPaintSphere(target, x, y, z, radius, color, strength = 1, falloff = 0.5) -> int` | Paints vertex colors inside a world-space sphere (Mesh Paint brush); returns the painted vertex count. color: {r,g,b,a} or [r,g,b,a]. |

## Scene

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetSceneCount() -> int` | Number of scenes enabled in Build Settings. |
| `GetSceneIndex() -> int` | Build Settings index of the running scene (-1 if not listed). |
| `GetSceneLoadError() -> string` | Why the last LoadScene call failed. |
| `GetSceneName() -> string` | Name of the running scene (file name without extension). |
| `LoadScene(nameOrIndex) -> bool` | Loads a scene at the end of the frame: a Build Settings index, a scene name ("Level2") or a path under Assets. |
| `QuitGame()` | Closes the game (stops Play mode in the editor). |
| `ReloadScene() -> bool` | Restarts the current scene (end of frame). |

## Scenes

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `LevelGetLoaded() -> [string]` | Names of the additively loaded levels. |
| `LevelIsLoaded(nameOrPath) -> bool` | True while the level is loaded. |
| `LevelLoadAdditive("Assets/Scenes/Dungeon.cqscene", x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) -> entity \| null` | Loads another scene's objects into the current one (under a "[Level] Name" root). |
| `LevelUnload(nameOrPath) -> bool` | Unloads an additively loaded level. |

## Scripting

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `StateGraphGetState(target) -> string` | The name of the current state. |
| `StateGraphSetVariable(target, "Name", value) -> bool` | Sets a variable read by Variable transitions. |
| `StateGraphTrigger(target, "Name") -> bool` | Sends a trigger to the State Graphs on this object. |

## Scripts

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `AddScript(target, "Assets/Scripts/Enemy.cqs") -> bool` | Attaches a script at runtime; Awake/Start run at the start of the next frame. |
| `BroadcastMessage("Method", ...args) -> int` | Calls a method on every active script in the scene; returns how many handled it. |
| `GetScriptField(target, "field") -> value` | Reads a public field of another entity's script (number, bool or text). |
| `GlobalGet(key, default = null) -> value` | Reads a shared value. |
| `GlobalHas(key) -> bool` | True if a shared value exists. |
| `GlobalSet(key, value) -> bool` | Shares a number / bool / text between scripts and scene loads for this play session. |
| `HasScript(target, "Enemy" = any) -> bool` | True if the entity has a script (by file name, path or class). |
| `InvokeMethod(target, "Method", ...args) -> value` | Calls a method on the first script of target that has it and returns its result (null if none). |
| `SendMessage(target, "Method", ...args) -> bool` | Calls a method on every script of an entity (true if any script has it). |
| `SetScriptField(target, "field", value) -> bool` | Writes a public field of another entity's script. |

## Signals

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `SignalConnect(source, "signal", target, "Method", oneShot = false) -> bool` | Godot-style signal: when source emits the signal, target's script method is called with the emitted arguments. |
| `SignalConnectionCount(source, "signal") -> int` | Number of receivers connected to a signal. |
| `SignalDisconnect(source, "signal", target, "Method") -> bool` | Removes a signal connection. |
| `SignalEmit(source, "signal", args...) -> int` | Emits a signal; returns how many receivers were called. Engine signals: body_entered/body_exited(other), collided(other, impulse), pressed, value_changed(value), submitted. |
| `SignalIsConnected(source, "signal", target, "Method") -> bool` | Whether the connection exists. |

## Splines

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `SplineAnimatePause(entity = self)` | Pauses a Spline Animate component. |
| `SplineAnimatePlay(entity = self)` | Starts / resumes a Spline Animate component. |
| `SplineAnimateRestart(entity = self)` | Restarts a Spline Animate component from its start offset. |
| `SplineEvaluate(splineEntity, t) -> {x, y, z}` | World point on a Spline Container at t (0..1, constant speed along the curve). |
| `SplineLength(splineEntity) -> float` | Curve length in metres (world space). |
| `SplineNearestT(splineEntity, point \| x, y, z) -> float` | t (0..1) of the curve point closest to a world position. |
| `SplineTangent(splineEntity, t) -> {x, y, z}` | Normalised world direction of the curve at t. |

## Steam

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `SteamCreateLobby(maxMembers, public?) -> bool` | Creates a lobby; OnSteamLobbyCreated(lobbyId) follows. |
| `SteamGetLastError() -> string` | Why Steam is not available. |
| `SteamGetLobbyData(lobbyId, key) -> string` | Reads lobby metadata. |
| `SteamGetLobbyOwner(lobbyId?) -> string` | SteamID of the lobby owner (connect to it with the Steam transport). |
| `SteamGetPersonaName() -> string` | The player's Steam name. |
| `SteamGetSteamId() -> string` | The player's 64-bit SteamID (as text). |
| `SteamIsAvailable() -> bool` | Loads steam_api and connects to the running Steam client. |
| `SteamJoinLobby(lobbyId) -> bool` | Joins a lobby; OnSteamLobbyEntered(lobbyId, ownerId) follows. |
| `SteamLeaveLobby()` | Leaves the current lobby. |
| `SteamRequestLobbyList() -> bool` | Searches public lobbies; OnSteamLobbyList(list) follows. |
| `SteamSetLobbyData(key, value) -> bool` | Metadata on the current lobby (owner only). |

## Testing

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `AssertEqual(actual, expected, message = "")` | Test Script: fails when the values differ. |
| `AssertFail(message)` | Test Script: fails the running test. |
| `AssertFalse(condition, message = "")` | Test Script: fails the running test when true. |
| `AssertNear(actual, expected, tolerance, message = "")` | Test Script: fails when the numbers differ by more than tolerance. |
| `AssertNotEqual(a, b, message = "")` | Test Script: fails when the values match. |
| `AssertTrue(condition, message = "")` | Test Script: fails the running test when false. |

## Time

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetDeltaTime() -> float` | Seconds since the last frame (scaled). |
| `GetTime() -> float` | Seconds since play started. |
| `GetTimeScale() -> float` | Global time scale. |
| `SetTimeScale(scale)` | 0 pauses, 1 normal, 2 double speed. |

## Timeline

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `TimelineBind(track, target, entity?) -> bool` | Binds a track (index or name) to an entity, like Unity's SetGenericBinding. Saved with the scene. |
| `TimelineGetDuration(entity?) -> float` | Length of the timeline in seconds. |
| `TimelineGetTime(entity?) -> float` | Current timeline time in seconds. |
| `TimelineIsPlaying(entity?) -> bool` | True while the timeline plays. |
| `TimelinePause(entity?) -> bool` | Pauses the timeline at the current time. |
| `TimelinePlay(entity?) -> bool` | Plays the Playable Director's timeline (restarts if it had finished). |
| `TimelineSetTime(seconds, entity?) -> bool` | Jumps to a time and evaluates every track (skipped signals do not fire). |
| `TimelineStop(entity?) -> bool` | Stops and rewinds the timeline. |

## Transform

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `GetForward() -> {x, y, z}` | Forward (-Z) direction in world space. |
| `GetPosition() -> {x, y, z}` | World position of this entity. |
| `GetRight() -> {x, y, z}` | Right (+X) direction in world space. |
| `GetRotation() -> {x, y, z}` | Euler rotation in degrees. |
| `GetScale() -> {x, y, z}` | Local scale. |
| `GetUp() -> {x, y, z}` | Up (+Y) direction in world space. |
| `SetPosition(x, y, z)` | Moves this entity. |
| `SetRotation(x, y, z)` | Sets Euler rotation in degrees. |
| `SetScale(x, y, z)` | Sets local scale. |

## Tween

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `Ease("bounce_out", t) -> float` | Evaluates an easing curve at t (0..1). |
| `TweenCount() -> int` | Number of running tweens. |
| `TweenIsActive(id) -> bool` | Whether the tween is still running. |
| `TweenKill(id, complete = false) -> bool` | Stops a tween (optionally jumping to its end value). |
| `TweenKillAll(target = self) -> int` | Stops every tween on the object. |
| `TweenPause(id, paused = true)` | Pauses or resumes a tween. |
| `TweenTo(target, "position"\|"rotation"\|"scale"\|"color"\|"alpha"\|"Component.Field", value, seconds, {ease: "sine_inout", delay, loops, yoyo, relative, onComplete: "Method"}) -> id` | Animates a property smoothly (Godot Tween / DOTween). Eases: linear, sine/quad/cubic/expo/back _in/_out/_inout, elastic_out, bounce_out. |

## UI

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `UICreateCanvas(name = "Canvas") -> entity` | Creates a screen-space canvas with a Canvas Scaler. |
| `UICreateElement(type, parent = canvas, name = "") -> entity` | Creates Panel, Image, Text, Button, Toggle, Slider, InputField, Dropdown, ScrollView or LayoutGroup. |
| `UIGetAlpha(target) -> float` | Canvas Group alpha (1 when there is none). |
| `UIGetEvents() -> [{name, type, entity, value}]` | UI events of this frame (Click, ValueChanged, Submit). |
| `UIGetFill(target) -> float` | Fill amount of a UI Image. |
| `UIGetPosition(target) -> {x, y}` | Anchored position of a Rect Transform. |
| `UIGetSelected() -> id` | Selected UI element, -1 if none. |
| `UIGetSize(target) -> {x, y}` | Laid-out size of a Rect Transform. |
| `UIGetText(target) -> string` | Text of a UI Text, Input Field, Text Renderer or the selected Dropdown option. |
| `UIGetValue(target) -> float \| bool \| int` | Slider value, Toggle state, Dropdown index, Scroll Rect or Scrollbar position. |
| `UIIsHovered(target) -> bool` | True while the pointer is over the selectable. |
| `UIIsInteractable(target) -> bool` | True if the selectable accepts input. |
| `UIIsPointerOver() -> bool` | True if the mouse is over an interactive UI element (ignore world clicks). |
| `UIIsVisible(target) -> bool` | True if the element and all its parents are active. |
| `UIQuery(document, "#name" \| ".class" \| "Type") -> entity` | Finds an element of a UI Document. |
| `UISetAlpha(target, alpha) -> bool` | Fades a whole UI subtree through its Canvas Group (added if missing). |
| `UISetColor(target, r, g, b, a = 1) -> bool` | Tints a UI Image (or UI Text / Sprite Renderer). |
| `UISetDropdownOptions(target, ["A", "B"]) -> bool` | Replaces the options of a Dropdown. |
| `UISetFill(target, amount) -> bool` | Fill amount 0..1 of a UI Image (Simple images switch to Filled). |
| `UISetFontSize(target, size) -> bool` | Font size of a UI Text / Input Field. |
| `UISetGroupInteractable(target, on) -> bool` | Enables / disables every selectable under the element through its Canvas Group. |
| `UISetImage(target, "Assets/Textures/x.png") -> bool` | Changes the texture of a UI Image or Raw Image (empty = plain color). |
| `UISetInteractable(target, interactable) -> bool` | Enables or disables a Button / Toggle / Slider / Input Field / Dropdown / Scrollbar. |
| `UISetPosition(target, x, y) -> bool` | Anchored position of a Rect Transform (canvas pixels). |
| `UISetRotation(target, degrees) -> bool` | Z rotation of a Rect Transform. |
| `UISetScale(target, sx, sy = sx) -> bool` | Scale of a Rect Transform (pulse / pop animations). |
| `UISetSelected(target \| null) -> bool` | Keyboard / gamepad selection (arrows, d-pad, Enter / A submits). |
| `UISetSize(target, width, height) -> bool` | Size delta of a Rect Transform (canvas pixels). |
| `UISetText(target, text) -> bool` | Sets the text of a UI Text / Input Field / Text Renderer (or a button's label). |
| `UISetTextColor(target, r, g, b, a = 1) -> bool` | Color of a UI Text (or a button's label). |
| `UISetUVRect(target, x, y, w, h) -> bool` | Texture rectangle (0..1) of a Raw Image: atlas regions, scrolling backgrounds. |
| `UISetValue(target, value) -> bool` | Value of a Slider (clamped), Toggle (on/off), Dropdown (index), Scroll Rect or Scrollbar; does not raise events. |
| `UISetVisible(target, visible) -> bool` | Shows or hides a UI element and its children (sets the entity active state). |
| `UIValueChanged(target) -> bool` | True in the frame a Toggle / Slider / Dropdown / Input Field changed or was submitted. |
| `UIWasClicked(target) -> bool` | True in the frame a button was clicked (button id, button name or its On Click name). |

## Video

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `VideoGetFrame([target]) -> int` | Index of the frame on screen. |
| `VideoGetLength([target]) -> float` | Video length (s). |
| `VideoGetTime([target]) -> float` | Current playback time (s). |
| `VideoIsPlaying([target]) -> bool` | True while the video plays. |
| `VideoPause([target])` | Pauses a Video Player. |
| `VideoPlay([target])` | Starts / resumes a Video Player (restarts if it had finished). |
| `VideoSeek([target,] seconds)` | Jumps to a time in the video. |
| `VideoStop([target])` | Stops and rewinds a Video Player. |
